description: Register a webhook so Oura notifies your callback URL when data changes. Oura verifies the URL before activating it, and the subscription EXPIRES — renew it with oura_renew_webhook_subscription. Oura: POST /v2/webhook/subscription.

callback_url.description: The HTTPS URL Oura should call.

data_type.description: Which collection to watch, e.g. daily_sleep or workout.

event_type.description: Which change to be notified about.

verification_token.description: A secret Oura echoes back so you can verify the callback.

name: oura_create_webhook_subscription
title: Create a webhook subscription
